title: Rupee falls 12 paise to 94.50 against U.S. dollar in early trade

title: HDFC Bank initiates internal probe into alleged data leak by two senior executives
description: In line with the bank's policies, the spokesperson said, an internal review into this matter is currently underway to gather and evaluate all relevant facts

title: The broken promise of the right to work
description: The replacement of MGNREGA with the VB-GRAM G Act has weakened the rural right-to-work framework; restoring a meaningful right to work through adequate funding, living wages and stronger local institutions would advance constitutional aims while also supporting rural demand and economic growth

title: Agrivoltaics on 10% of suitable land can meet 2050 power demand: Pralhad Joshi
description: Pralhad Joshi, Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy also stated the government is working to add a dedicated component for agrivoltaics in the second phase of PM-Kusum.

title: India is a highly fragmented media viewing market, says U.S. audience measurement firm Nielsen

title: Thiagarajar Group and German company to invest ₹100 crore at Virudhunagar
description: A company of the Madurai-based Thiagarajar Group and German firm Euro Textiles will invest ₹100 crore to set up a fabric production unit at Virudhunagar in Tamil Nadu.
